title: Formal Bayesian Transfer Learning via the Total Risk Prior
abstract: arXiv:2507.23768v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing methods for transfer learning struggle to deal with situations where the source datasets are limited and not guaranteed to be well-aligned with the target dataset. A typical strategy is to use the empirical loss minimizer on the source data as a prior mean for the target parameters. Our key conceptual contribution is to use a risk minimizer conditional on source parameters instead. This allows us to construct a single joint prior distribution for all parameters from the source datasets as well as the target dataset. As a consequence, we benefit from full Bayesian uncertainty quantification and can perform model averaging via Gibbs sampling over indicator variables governing the inclusion of each source dataset. We show how a particular instantiation of our prior leads to a Bayesian Lasso in a transformed coordinate system and discuss computational techniques to scale our approach to moderately sized datasets. translated_title: 基于总风险先验的正式贝叶斯迁移学习
translated_abstract: 现有的迁移学习方法难以应对源数据集有限且无法保证与目标数据集良好对齐的情况。一种典型的策略是将源数据上的经验损失最小化器用作目标参数的先验均值。我们的关键概念性贡献是改为使用以源参数为条件的风险最小化器。这使得我们能够基于源数据集和目标数据集为所有参数构建一个单一的联合先验分布。因此，我们可以获得完整的贝叶斯不确定性量化，并可以通过对控制每个源数据集是否被纳入的指示变量进行吉布斯采样（Gibbs sampling）来执行模型平均。我们展示了该先验的一种特定实例化如何在变换后的坐标系中导出贝叶斯Lasso，并讨论了将我们的方法扩展到中等规模数据集的计算技术。我们讨论了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的贝叶斯迁移学习方法，其核心创新在于使用以源参数为条件的风险最小化器（而非传统的经验损失最小化器）来构建源数据集与目标数据集所有参数的单一联合先验分布，从而实现完整的贝叶斯不确定性量化以及通过Gibbs采样对源数据集进行选择和模型平均。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel Bayesian transfer learning approach whose key innovation is using a risk minimizer conditional on source parameters (instead of the empirical loss minimizer) to construct a single joint prior distribution for all parameters from source and target datasets, enabling full Bayesian uncertainty quantification and model averaging via Gibbs sampling over source dataset inclusion indicators.
